_comment: sim-carton-level-southdock-v1 loaded gravity-droop FEEDFORWARD for the collect place-on-cart carton level. Purpose: stop the carton-level guard tripping in the PLACE set-down at the PR-307 south dock (coldwin31: CARTON_TILT roll=-0.04 pitch=+2.07 deg, phase=place, sustained 0.167s > the 0.150s grace). Root cause: the welded arm is far-extended at the sensed south-dock deck set-down (REPOSITION_REREGISTER place=(1.043,0.055,0.435) in ur_base_link), so the shoulder_lift gravity torque (~58 N*m) droops the physical joints BELOW the geometrically-level command and the carton pitches ~2 deg off level. This is QUASI-STATIC (torque/stiffness), NOT velocity lag -- PR 302's 0.02 rad/s gentling could not help (coldwin31 ran it and still hit 2.07). The fix re-solves the level place/preplace IK so the COMMANDED config whose EXECUTED (drooped) pose is level, i.e. pre-tilt the command against the expected droop. Merge this into the carton_level block in the mission runtime-config HOST block (the block read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py). The captain-fixed 2.0 deg bound and 0.15 s grace are UNCHANGED. Absent gravity_compensation => byte-identical (the geometric level solve, as before).
_carton_level_note: Keep the rest of the carton_level block exactly as the lane runs it (bound_deg 2.0, tilt_grace_s 0.15, level_goals/level_place/level_path on). Only the gravity_compensation sub-block is new. carton_level is a HOST key (config_preflight: HOST) -- it must be in the host config the manip host reads (scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json merge / the integration host block), not a runtime-only file, or it silently never activates.
_gravity_compensation_note: stiffness_nm_per_rad is the EFFECTIVE droop stiffness (N*m/rad): the finite-servo residual after the host's own gravity FF. 2850 is pinned so the physical gravity-torque model (real mission-URDF link masses + the welded carton) reproduces coldwin31's observed +2.07 deg at the south dock (model 2.03 deg) and the east cart's 1.86 deg (which collectlevel4 saw as a sub-grace transient and PASSED). carton_mass_kg is the welded handling-unit mass lumped at the tool for the torque (the juice_orange profile mass 0.45). max_pretilt_rad (default 0.12) clamps each joint's commanded pre-tilt so a mis-calibration can never command a large attitude offset. LOWER stiffness => MORE pre-tilt; raise it if the in-sim executed over-corrects (overshoots level the other way).
_bounded_gpu_proof: Cold collect-only (RESTOCK_COLLECT_GROUND_TRUTH=1 if the source decode is not the focus, visuals per the lane) at the PR-307 south dock geometry (mission_poses.place_approach = the derive_place_approach for the (-4.60, 16.0, -pi/2) dock), through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock, with carton_level.gravity_compensation merged into the HOST block. Expected PASS: NO CARTON_TILT through pre-place, place and release (the place set-down lands the welded carton level); HOST_EFFECTIVE_CONFIG / the controller logs show carton_level active; orch-console.log now carries the per-segment CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT phase=place executed_max ... line (previously absent -- it keyed off the reassigned phase and never emitted). Tune: if the place executed residual is still off the bound, adjust stiffness_nm_per_rad from the logged executed-vs-planned (CARTON_SEGMENT_TILT) -- lower stiffness => more pre-tilt. Do NOT loosen bound_deg or tilt_grace_s (captain-fixed).
